# Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
42 0 248

![Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19](https://blog.playstation.com/tachyon/2026/11/fc43cd44ef39d1697bb5bef1fca7d08e7f90c647.jpg?resize=1088%2C612&crop_strategy=smart)

Like thisLike this

![](https://blog.playstation.com/tachyon/2021/10/ffd5ad352deb3eea48ea3d05647453367dbb002e.jpg?fit=40%2C40)

[R*Q](https://blog.playstation.com/author/rockstarq/)

Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them.

[Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 Thursday, November 19, available at PlayStation Store.](https://www.playstation.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/?srsltid=AYCX9vKskWfYvD33EBG0VSsbiIscizVTgEmwdq_2LROs75EVHX79ujlJ)

![](https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55656550652_ae44cc16c0_k.jpg)

![](https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55657559960_e75c0acd33_k.jpg)

## **When the sun fades and the neon glows, everyone has something to gain — and more to lose**
The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet.

## The sprawling state of Leonida
### Vice City
We’re a long way from the ’80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America

## Broadcasting live across Leonida

# First look at the Grand Theft Auto VI Limited-Edition DualSense Wireless Controllers
From its sun-soaked streets to its bright neon lights, the city will be Leonida’s ultimate destination when players jump into [Grand Theft Auto VI](https://www.playstation.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/) on November 19.

Find out more on how Grand Theft Auto VI [plays best on PS5](https://blog.playstation.com/2026/06/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-plays-best-on-ps5-november-19/) when it launches on November 19 and [check out Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look here](https://www.playstation.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/).

web.title: Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation ...
web.description:
[![playstation.com](https://blog.playstation.com/content/themes/playstation-2018/images/sonylogo-2x.jpg)](https://www.playstation.com/)

# Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
## **Celebrating a historic launch**
More than **39 million unique players** have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5.

## **Thank you for being part of this moment**
With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City.

_*All figures are based on SIE internal data collected from November 19, 2026, to November 22, 2026_
